wish: someone should make a tool that detects the BPM of an audio file
spec:
Opens an audio file, decodes it on this device and estimates its tempo in BPM from onset autocorrelation.
Pick a file (or drop one), read the BPM, fix half/double time with x1/2 or x2, play it with a click on the detected grid, or tap along to cross-check.
It does not upload anything, edit tags in the file, or handle tempo changes within a track.
notes: File analysis checked locally with synthetic WAVs at 87, 93.5, 100, 120, 128, 140 BPM (all exact); a 174 BPM track reads 87, fixed with x2. Tests cover tap tempo because verify cannot pick a file.
